topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Browsing through rows of old, forgotten items, my fingers pause on a well-worn, familiar shape. It’s soft, slightly lumpy, and the fabric is thinner, more faded than I remember. My eyes dart up to the tag, half-expecting to see a price tag from a store long out of business. But it's a yard sale sticker, taped on carelessly. I turn it over, and there, stitched in faded blue thread, are the initials I hadn’t seen in years: “MB.” The sun seems to shift, warming my back as I clutch the bear, feeling the weight of time soften in my hands. It’s like pieces of a puzzle I thought lost forever are slowly, miraculously, coming together.
